# prodigal

> 1. carelessly wasteful; extravagant
> 2. a person who is excessively wasteful

> Wasteful, extravagant; giving abundantly, lavish


## Example

- *Successful professional athletes who do not fall prey to prodigality seem to be the exception--most live decadent lives.*
